AI/ML Engineer & Creative Technologist · Greater Noida, India

I'm Satyarth Mishra, an AI/ML engineer and creative technologist based in Greater Noida, India. I build with computer vision, edge AI, digital products and visual storytelling.

I'm studying B.Tech in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at GLA University (2025–2029). My toolkit includes Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, FastAPI, Raspberry Pi and ESP32.

From VEENA's disaster-response rover to AI workflows and interactive web experiences, I connect engineering with design. I also create Blender models, motion graphics and workshop creatives for Synapse AI Club.
